infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: GNBEdge needs your location while you are on duty so managers can see your live driver position.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: GNBEdge needs Always location access only when you choose Always sharing for on-duty driver tracking.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: GNBEdge needs the camera to photograph bills, fuel receipts, consignment notes and proof-of-delivery.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: GNBEdge needs photo access so you can attach existing bill, receipt and delivery photos.
